## Overview

Traditional weather portals primarily display raw surface variables like temperature, relative humidity, and 24-hour precipitation accumulation. While informative, these raw fields often obscure the broader synoptic drivers powering severe weather events.

The **Value Added Weather Forecasts (VAWF)** platform bridges this gap by automatically detecting, isolating, and visualizing high-order dynamical features directly from numerical weather prediction (NWP) model outputs.

---

## Key Atmospheric Features Tracked

| Feature | Diagnostic Focus | Practical Significance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Atmospheric Rivers (ARs)** | Integrated Vapor Transport (IVT) corridors | Extreme precipitation & flood risk assessment |
| **Jet Streams** | Upper-level velocity fields (250 hPa isotachs) | Steering dynamics & synoptic pattern evolution |
| **Ongoing Cyclones** | Vorticity centers & surface pressure minima | Tracking storm tracks & severe weather potential |
| **Precipitation Anomalies** | Departure from historical climatology | Early warning for extreme regional rainfall |

---

## Operational Workflow

:::{.grid}

:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
:::{.card .mb-3}
:::{.card-body}
**1. Forecast Data Ingestion**
Automated pipelines fetch daily numerical forecast feeds (ECMWF / GFS) across multi-level atmospheric variables.
:::
:::
:::

:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
:::{.card .mb-3}
:::{.card-body}
**2. Feature Extraction**
Applies geometric and thresholding algorithms to extract distinct phenomena (e.g., IVT moisture plumes, jet axes).
:::
:::
:::

:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
:::{.card .mb-3}
:::{.card-body}
**3. Value-Added Layering**
Synthesizes complex 3D fields into clean vector-overlay layers for seamless multi-feature comparison.
:::
:::
:::

:::{.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
:::{.card .mb-3}
:::{.card-body}
**4. Automated Rendering**
Generates lightweight HTML/JS web maps updated on schedule for rapid web-based analysis.
:::
:::
:::

:::

## Research & Educational Disclaimer
Value Added Weather Forecasts (VAWF) is an open-source academic research prototype developed by Dr. Arjun Babu Nellikkattil. It is **not** an official operational safety dashboard. Please rely on official government entities (e.g., NOAA NWS, ECMWF, or national meteorological offices) for official weather advisories and emergency warnings.
:::
